card.name: Small words before a news outlet or credit
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation just before a name is expected, such as a photo credit, a source line, or a TV network name. Seen in news-style web text after 'Source', 'Photo', 'Credit', 'followed by', 'produced by'.

modes.label: Credit line colon
modes.description: A colon right after Source, Photo or Credit, before the name of the credit.

modes.label: Linking word before a name
modes.description: A word like by, and, at or including that comes before a named group, person or program.
modes.example: followed<< by>> the US Air Force (37 million

modes.label: Before a network name
modes.description: A separator in a list of broadcast channels, just before CNN.
modes.example: CNN U.S.: Sundays 10 a.m. & 1 p.m ET |<< CNN>> International: Find local times Check out

card.writes: It pushes the model toward outputting CNN and TED style media names.
card.plain: It fires on small words that come right before a credit or a news or media name, like CNN or TED.
